# Antik Surf Club

> Antik Surf Club is a surf school based in Asilah, Morocco, offering surf lessons, surf trips, surf equipment rental and local surf experiences.

Antik Surf Club helps visitors discover surfing in Asilah and the Moroccan coastline through professional surf coaching, guided surf trips and authentic local experiences.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://antiksurf.com/): Official website of Antik Surf Club.
- [Surf Trips](https://antiksurf.com/en/surftrips): Information about surf trips, accommodation and surf experiences.
- [Events](https://antiksurf.com/en/events): Surf events and special activities organised by Antik Surf Club.

## Services

- [Surf Lessons](https://antiksurf.com/en): Surf classes for beginners and experienced surfers in Asilah.
- [Surf Equipment Rental](https://antiksurf.com/en): Surfboard and equipment rental services.
- [Surf Trips](https://antiksurf.com/en/surftrips): Surf holidays and surf experiences in Morocco.

## Location

Antik Surf Club is located in Asilah, Morocco, offering surf experiences on the Atlantic coast.
